sentences.text: Blue Balls Oy is a newly registered company, entered in the register on 2026-09-04 under the industry code 70200, management consultancy activities.
First sales are recorded on 2026-09-04, and a start-up notification and a board change were registered on 2026-10-07.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file.
For the fund this is a watchlist case: the name has a blue word, but the registered industry is consultancy and the record shows no ocean use.
